method: Manual visual readings from native PDF screenshot; not automatic tracing or author raw data.
selection: Main laser band only, chosen where curves are visible. Values rounded to 1e-22 cm^2.
limitations: Line overlap, finite figure resolution and steep peak cause substantial error.
No claim of a calibrated confidence interval or 2-nm instrument resolution.
The independent HASEonGPU RT spectrum is NOT renormalized to these readings.
Do not use this dataset as publication-grade or validated NN-training ground truth.
